newsitem.title: USA: U.S. says it will judge Iraq on actions not words.
newsitem.headline: U.S. says it will judge Iraq on actions not words.

text.p: The White House said on Friday in response to reports Iraq might suspend its military challenges to allied no-fly zones that the United States would judge Baghdad on its actions, not its statements.

"The president himself has said it is actions that speak louder than words and we'll be looking at actions not statements from Baghdad," White House spokesman Mike McCurry said when asked about reports from Baghdad suggesting Iraq might be seeking to defuse a military showdown with the United States.
